dogecoin.text:
Solana(Sol): A fast, low-cost competitor to Ethereum.

Cardano(ADA): A research driven Blockchain focused on security and scalability.

Dogecoin(DOGE): Started as a joke but gained popularity (used for tipping and payment).

Crypto simply explained
Imagine money that isn’t controlled by banks, works 24/7, and can’t be counterfeited—welcome to the world of cryptocurrencies! 

Whether you’ve heard of Bitcoin, Ethereum, or Dogecoin, this simple guide breaks it all down in plain English. Let’s dive in
